additional_documents.title: Fixture: superseded consumer-acceptance gate
additional_documents.text: Historical evaluation fixture: the old consumer-acceptance publication gate required a downstream accepted receipt before Feature 1 could activate its producer release. A rejected consumer import kept the predecessor active. This describes the superseded gate, not the current ADR-041 producer-owned policy.
